name.baseName: Disposal, tailings from hard coal milling, in impoundment

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Average coal tailings composition from literature references. Transfer coefficients from prospective model, specific to coal tailings.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Data represents a worldwide average. Generic water infiltration rate according to weighted mean of major sites of coal tailings production in the world.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Mechanically stable and revegetated coal tailings impoundment

# Included processes
Waste-specific emissions from lignite spoil leachate. Short- and long-term emissions to groundwater from rainwater infiltration leaching. Leaching by lateral groundwater flow not included.; Geography: Data represents a worldwide average. Generic water infiltration rate according to weighted mean of major sites of coal tailings production in the world.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Disposal model based on observed leachate concentrations in literature. Extrapolated to 60'000 years heeding chemical characteristics. Initial tailings composition from various literature sources.

review.common:reviewDetails: Proof reading validation: passed.; Other validation: none;

publicationAndOwnership.common:accessRestrictions: All information can be accessed by everybody.
